description: Add one recipient to an active triggered project. The person gets the project message, now or after its delay (held until 8 AM if it comes due between 10 PM and 8 AM their time). This sends a real text. Answers queued with send_at, or already_entered with a reason (duplicate, already_entered, too_soon). A paused project returns 409 CONFLICT; an opted-out number returns 409 CONTACT_OPTED_OUT.

confirm.description: Must be true to run this write operation. Set it only after the user has explicitly confirmed.

fields.description: Optional merge-tag values for this recipient (up to 50 keys, scalar values). They are stored on the recipient and appear in reports, exports, and webhook contact.custom_fields.

occurrence_id.description: Your id for the event, so a retry of the same event is a no-op

phone_number.description: US phone number in +1 E.164 format

name: add_project_recipient
